Date : 7th August, 2025 P.C. :
1. Heard learned advocates for the parties.

2.  This is an application seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R No. 508 of 2022 registered with Yerwada Police Station for offence punishable under Section 328, 188, 272, 273 read with Section 34 of IPC and Section 26(2)(i), (iv), 27(3)(d),
3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The Applicant was protected by interim order of this Court on 19.10.2023.
4.

It was pointed out on the last occasion that after interim protection was granted in this application, one more FIR is filed bearing No. 1171 of 2023 with Kondhwa Police Station for same offence against the Applicant, who is accused No.2 in said FIR No.
1171 of 2023.
Other earlier FIRs were also pointed out.

sentences.text: Perusal of the allegations in present FIR and the subsequent FIR No. 1171 of 2023 indicates that the allegations are identical inasmuch as the vehicle carrying contraband material (Gutkha Pan Masala etc.),
the driver of the vehicle has named the present Applicant as a person for whom the contraband was being carried or on whose instance the said contraband is stated to be carried.

6. Today, learned Counsel for the Applicant submits that in 3 earlier FIRs namely 948/2020,
1143/2020 and 795/2022, the Applicant has been acquitted.
He submits that the application of Section 328 of IPC to Gutkha is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and submits that on this count alone, the anticipatory bail application be allowed.

7. It is already noted in the last order that record indicates that Applicant's name is cropping up at the instance of various drivers when the vehicles are intercepted carrying the same contraband material.

8. Learned APP on instructions of concerned Investigating Officer (who is present in the Court) has strenuously opposed this application on the ground that considering various FIRs, the Applicant is a habitual offender and is a supplier of the contraband material involved in the FIR.
It is contended that even after interim protection is secured from this Court in the present matter, subsequent FIR No. 1171 of 2023 is filed in the same area and therefore, no indulgence been shown.

9. In the aforesaid facts and circumstances, considering that the Applicant's name is taken time and again by various drivers of vehicles carrying same contraband material, and considering that after interim 47-ABA-2926-2023.doc order by this Court, the Applicant's name has again surfaced in connection with subsequent FIR No. 1171/2023, serious note will have to be taken about the Applicant's alleged continued involvement in similar activities.
Therefore the Applicant will have to be put to terms.

10. Hence, the following order:
(i) The anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 19.10.2023.

(ii) It is clarified that if the Applicant's name surfaces during investigation in any subsequent FIR involving transport of Gutkha, present anticipatory bail granted in favour of Applicant will be vacated automatically.
9. Anticipatory bail application is disposed of in above terms.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
